chatter.🐦 Social Sentiment — *Divided Nation*:
The mood on X and Reddit this holiday weekend is **sharply split**. The bulls are pointing to a massive **$650B reversal in Asian markets**, led by South Korean semiconductor and tech stocks recovering from the June 8 KOSPI crash. @coinbureau flagged that **U.S. household equity exposure hit a record high** — more wealth tied to stocks than ever, which cuts both ways.

But the bears are louder.

@DeFiTracer dropped an ominous warning: *"Four separate pressure points hitting simultaneously. Any one alone would move markets. Together they create something the financial system hasn't seen."*

The dominant theme is the **Fed under Kevin Warsh**. @CryptoNobler reports **9 of 12 FOMC members support a 25bps hike in July**. Warsh himself vowed to *"disappoint anyone expecting tolerance for inflation above 2%"* — straight from @Polymarket's feed. Polymarket odds still favor no hike, but **BofA and Deutsche Bank expect 75bps of tightening by year-end**.

Meanwhile @WeTheBrandon paints a rosy picture: *"Inflation cooling, wages rising, paychecks growing faster than prices."* Two Americas, one market.

**Earnings season** kicks off next week: **$PEP**, **$DAL**, **$PENG**, **$LEVI**.

---
chatter.📉 After-Hours Movers — *Record Dow vs. S:
Cash markets were **closed Friday for July 4th observance**, so all eyes are on Thursday July 2's tape:

- **Dow Jones** surged **+600 points** to a **fresh all-time record** — value and industrial strength
- **Nasdaq** sank as **AI and semiconductor stocks** continued their sell-off
- **S&P 500** finished **flat**, caught in the crossfire
- **After-hours**: S&P 500 eked out **+0.12%** while Nasdaq futures stayed under pressure
- **Gold surged**, the **dollar weakened** — classic risk-off positioning

The **Dow/Nasdaq divergence** is the defining technical setup. Old economy at all-time highs; AI valuations resetting. Barchart called it *"holiday-thin trade"* — but the signal is clear: **rotation is real.**

---
chatter.🔮 Next Day Setup — *Data-Driven Week Ahe:
Markets return **Tuesday** after the long weekend. Here's what's on deck:

📅 **Earnings**: **$PEP** and **$DAL** headline — consumer health and travel demand as a macro read-through

🏛️ **Fed Watch**: Every FOMC comment matters. The **July 29 meeting** is the main event; next week's **CPI** and **PPI** prints are the dry run. If data runs hot, the 25bps hike probability jumps.

🌏 **Asia Bounce**: Watch if the **semiconductor recovery** in Korea and Taiwan holds into U.S. session — it would signal that AI sell-off is a rotation, not a crash

💵 **Dollar weakness + gold surge** = hedging ahead of the Warsh decision. The **2-year yield** is the tell — if it pushes through resistance, rate-hike expectations are solidifying.

**TL;DR:** Split tape, hawkish Fed, earnings season ignition. Expect **volatility** — buckle up.
